clues.text: In Bethlehem at barley harvest, a Moabite widow happened to glean in the field belonging to this man.
During a Bethlehem harvest, he told his young men to pull stalks from the bundles and leave them for Ruth.
At midnight on the threshing floor, this man woke startled to find a woman lying at his feet.
He poured six measures of barley into Ruth's shawl so she would not return to Naomi empty-handed.
At the town gate before ten elders, a nearer kinsman-redeemer took off his sandal and told this man to buy the land.
In Matthew's genealogy of Jesus, this man's mother was Rahab, and his son Obed was born to Ruth.
At the portico of Solomon's temple, the north pillar bore this name, while the south pillar was called Jachin.
